purpose: Living internal claim-evidence registry; not an abstract, title, manuscript conclusion, or final delivery of failed routes.

publication_gate.rule: Only direct evidence for the exact claim can change current_status to SUPPORTED; numerical correctness, smoke completion, raw ranking, one seed, or a failed route cannot support a performance, mechanism, OOD, long-sequence, or SOTA claim.

claims.claim: Isolated, long-span, and competitive environments are reproducible error modes that local pair scoring fails to resolve.
claims.phenomenon: Frozen three-seed VL0 controls have 372 isolated true pairs, 319 isolated FN, recall 0.1424731182795699, and isolated FN comprise 0.1070110701107011 of all FN; long-span and competitive strata still require multi-environment confirmation.
claims.intervention: Run frozen family/cluster/length/span/topology error decomposition, then test non-local context rather than another local capacity or stacking module.
claims.expected_observation: Target-environment recall and precision improve with paired sequence/family-cluster 95% CIs, adequate sequence and pair counts, no single-family driver, and preservation of micro/macro pair-F1 and stem-F1.
claims.limitation: VL0 has only 196 sequences and the isolated stratum is small and descriptive; it cannot establish universality, causality, or an intervention effect.

claims.claim: Global Ensemble Context improves isolated/long-span pairing and whole-structure metrics through non-local ensemble feedback.
claims.phenomenon: Local scores can change without preserving macro pair/stem structure; the preregistered H-GEC causal hypothesis remains untested scientifically.
claims.intervention: Matched-control four-arm seed0 pilot: exact stopped non-crossing posterior/interval context versus matched control, interval shuffle, and independent sigmoid context, with identical initialization, data order, budget, structured NLL, unfreezing, and MEA.
claims.expected_observation: Ensemble context passes every seed0 gate: nonnegative micro pair-F1 delta, strictly positive macro pair-F1 delta, precision and micro/macro stem-F1 losses no greater than 0.005, strict non-single-family isolated or long-span gain, and preregistered advantages over both destroy controls; only then three seeds and multi-environment confirmation are allowed.
claims.limitation: Numerical and two-step smoke evidence is engineering-only. Seed0 v2 failed at the first validation serialization with a non-finite float before scientific evaluation; its peer arm was terminated and the remaining arms were not launched. V1 also stopped on an arm failure without evaluation. These engineering failures do not falsify H-GEC and raw AUPRC or training loss cannot rescue failed structural gates.

claims.claim: Single-variable source/family, topology/long-span, or quality interventions improve macro generalization without sacrificing micro performance.
claims.phenomenon: Development audits show heterogeneous sources, TR1c duplicate IDs, CHANRG train/validation 80% homology, cross-source exact sequence overlap, and unresolved label/exposure layers; these are risks, not proof that reweighting will help.
claims.intervention: Open only a diagnostics-motivated, preregistered source_family_balanced, topology_longspan_balanced, or quality_filtered arm against the identical model and optimization budget.
claims.expected_observation: Macro pair/stem and target-environment retention improve while micro is preserved, deletion/sampling conservation is reported, and the effect survives paired uncertainty and family concentration checks.
claims.limitation: The completed audit is descriptive only; no sampling, cleaning, or training arm has run. Matched-clean accounting authorizes no route decision and no causal attribution.

claims.claim: One frozen FoldNar candidate preserves gains across family, topology, length, temporal, source, and pretraining-exposure shifts.
claims.phenomenon: Current development panels freeze only specific TR1c family/cluster separations; broader homology, structure similarity, pretraining exposure, and temporal/label lineage remain unchecked.
claims.intervention: After seed0, three-seed, and multi-environment gates, freeze model, data, checkpoint, decoder, and hyperparameters before any external read; evaluate the same candidate on all preregistered OOD slices.
claims.expected_observation: Pair/stem/junction/topology and span/length gains persist with full coverage, per-sequence predictions, paired 95% CIs, Holm correction, explicit exposure strata, and no test-driven revision within the same evaluation version.
claims.limitation: No candidate is selected and external evaluation is closed. NOT_DETECTED_UNKNOWN is not clean; temporal candidates and auxiliary PDB/DSSR assets remain blocked.

claims.claim: FoldNar exceeds the strongest same-protocol baselines across the eight main benchmarks, Rfam, CHANRG splits, and long sequences.
claims.phenomenon: Raw bpRNA-new measurements show a large xens2 gap, while unified baseline provenance and full prediction coverage are incomplete.
claims.intervention: Recover official assets and frozen per-sequence predictions, then evaluate one frozen candidate with matched labels, sequences, coverage, metrics, training protocol, model/ensemble class, and exact/approximate execution columns.
claims.expected_observation: The candidate beats the strongest comparable system on the same sequences, labels, coverage, and metrics across every required task, with micro/macro pair-F1, P/R, stem/junction/topology, length/span, coverage, paired 95% CIs, Holm correction, and compute cost.
claims.limitation: Current unified complete SOTA is 0/8. Sixty-two of 63 baselines remain BLOCKED_PROVENANCE; raw, own-clean, matched-clean, CHANRG, summary-only, and different-label results cannot be mixed. Historical 6/8 is not the current candidate's unified SOTA.

claims.claim: Sparse approximate GEC retains non-crossing interval semantics and accurate full-length predictions on 7,224- and 19,000-nt RNAs with tractable compute.
claims.phenomenon: Exact inside/outside is O(L^3) time with O(L^2) states; short-sequence numerical correctness does not imply long-sequence feasibility.
claims.intervention: Only after exact short-sequence GEC passes, preregister block-sparse/candidate-interval inference and compare against exact execution and LinearPartition-class methods without truncating or deleting targets.
claims.expected_observation: Full-length output success and candidate pair/helix recall precede pair/stem/topology and long-span accuracy; report omitted-pair recall, probability-mass error, coverage, memory, FLOPs, wall time, and accuracy-compute tradeoffs under APPROXIMATE_SPARSE.
claims.limitation: Both long-chain assets are BLOCKED in the data registry. No sparse GEC result exists; checkpointing changes memory only, and approximate inference must never be called exact global DP.

claims.claim: The implemented GEC numerical context and four-arm training path pass their preregistered engineering checks.
claims.phenomenon: Scientific interpretation first requires valid canonical masks, finite logZ, symmetric bounded pair marginals, per-nucleotide mass conservation, short-sequence exhaustive equivalence, deterministic destroy behavior, and resumable matched training.
claims.intervention: Run float64 exact non-crossing CPU/CUDA numerical tests, independent exhaustive checks, and a real two-step four-arm smoke with interruption/resume.
claims.expected_observation: All focused checks pass within float64 atol/rtol 2e-10 and mass atol 2e-09; all arms complete two optimizer steps with common initialization/batch order and no CPU fallback.
claims.limitation: SUPPORTED is restricted to numerical/engineering readiness: 12 CPU passes with 6 CUDA-hidden skips, 6 CUDA passes with 12 deselections, 5 independent passes, 1,280 exhaustive cases, and two-step smoke. It is not accuracy, calibration, novelty, convergence, or long-sequence evidence.

claims.claim: On frozen raw project bpRNA-new labels, xens2 has a substantial exact strict micro-F1 gap to MXfold2, EternaFold, and the frozen BPfold replay.
claims.phenomenon: xens2 strict micro-F1 is 0.5531420736; all three comparator predictions cover 5,388/5,388 sequences under exact zero-based inclusive pair matching.
claims.intervention: Independently recompute pooled TP/FP/FN and strict micro-F1 from frozen predictions without crossing-pair or short-span filtering, preserving official-versus-project label identities.
claims.expected_observation: Absolute comparator-minus-xens2 gaps are 0.1157045435284047 for MXfold2, 0.132241933669125 for EternaFold, and 0.1838653448282851 for the frozen project BPfold replay.
claims.limitation: SUPPORTED is restricted to PROJECT_RAW_GT_ONLY arithmetic and coverage. Training-union/homology overlap remains unresolved, so these are not clean, decontaminated, external-OOD, or unified SOTA conclusions. Official BPfold predictions score 0.9616708875167174 on project labels but 0.633624758107719 on all 5,401 official-label records; the former is a label-sensitive audit, not an official-result or comparator gap.

baseline_gaps.scope: PROJECT_RAW_GT_ONLY; frozen project bprna_new.jsonl; zero-based inclusive exact pairs; no added crossing or short-span filter; pooled strict micro-F1; raw non-decontaminated comparison

rows.protocol: official serial CONTRAfold-derived predict default MEA; frozen per-sequence predictions
six-model BPfold_predict; project labels; raw non-decontaminated

data_governance.scope: CPU-only TR1c and CHANRG Train/Validation; no Test/GenA/GenC/GenF access; no sampling intervention
findings: CHANRG raw Train/Validation has HOMOLOGY at the registered 80% check; 3,250 shared clusters motivate conservative accounting exclusions of 16,322 Train and 4,668 Validation rows.
TR1c versus CHANRG Train and Validation each has EXACT sequence overlap; cross-source broader homology is UNCHECKED.
Exact topology-signature overlap is not a structural-similarity search.
Chemical modified-parent mapping and per-record experimental lineage are unavailable in aggregated JSONL; dataset-level labels must not be called uniformly experimental truth.
Pretraining exposure and temporal/label provenance remain UNCHECKED; NOT_DETECTED_UNKNOWN never means clean.
Frozen CHANRG Train/Validation and external CHANRG splits are subset/version mismatches against contract counts and must remain explicitly scoped.

raw export, per-sequence predictions, and independent metric recomputation
same-sequence/label/metric/coverage strongest baselines with missing cells explicit
micro/macro pair-F1, P/R, stem/junction/topology, length/span, coverage, paired 95% CI, Holm correction, and compute cost

rules: Do not truncate or delete 7,224/19,000-nt targets.
Separate encoder, candidate generation, and complete-structure output acceptance.
Measure candidate pair/helix recall before pair/stem/topology accuracy and compute.
Label sparse execution APPROXIMATE_SPARSE and compare coverage/accuracy with LinearPartition-class methods.
Do not present gradient checkpointing as a mathematical or architecture contribution.

next_evidence_actions: Diagnose the non-finite step-500 validation value from preserved seed0 v2 artifacts, add a finite-value engineering gate before any new attempt, and never convert the serialization failure into a scientific verdict or final delivery.
If seed0 passes, run preregistered three-seed and multi-environment confirmation with the additional close-prior controls before any external evaluation.
Recover missing baseline provenance/predictions and blocked temporal/long-chain assets in parallel without external-test model development.
Open a data intervention only when development diagnostics justify one single-variable arm with equal budget.
